tagline.zh: 用户认为美观的设计更好用:美观度与「感知易用性」的相关性强于与「实际易用性」的相关性。美观带来容忍,也可能遮蔽可用性问题。
tagline.en: Users judge beautiful designs as more usable: aesthetics correlates with *perceived* ease of use more strongly than with *actual* ease of use. Beauty buys tolerance — and can mask real problems.

origin.zh: 1995 年 Kurosu & Kashimura(日立设计中心):26 种 ATM 界面变体 × 252 名参与者,美观评分与感知易用性的相关性强于与实际易用性的相关性(out/design-study/12-expansion.md §14;lawsofux aesthetic-usability-effect 页)。
origin.en: Kurosu & Kashimura (Hitachi Design Center, 1995): 26 ATM interface layouts × 252 participants; aesthetics correlated with perceived usability more strongly than with actual usability (out/design-study/12-expansion.md §14; the lawsofux aesthetic-usability-effect page).

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后切换右侧卡片 data-beauty):右侧卡的完成度档位。plain=与左侧素坯完全一致(退化为 A/A 自对照);refined=圆角 14px+柔和阴影+accent 主色;premium=在精修上叠渐变头部、18px 大圆角与更大留白。只改装饰层,两侧功能按钮的布局与数量完全一致。
effect.en: JS-type param (demo subscribes and toggles the right card's data-beauty): the right card's finish level. plain = identical to the left plain card (degenerates into an A/A self-control); refined = 14px radius + soft shadow + accent color; premium = refined plus a gradient header, 18px radius and more whitespace. Only the decoration layer changes — button layout and count stay identical on both sides.

effect.zh: JS 型参数:向两侧等量注入同一真实可用性缺陷(受控变量)。small-target=菜单按钮压到 18px 高;slow-response=成功反馈延迟 900ms(处理中状态)。设计意图:同一缺陷下,精修一侧的感知评分跌幅更小——这就是「美观带来容忍」。两个数值均为演示缺陷值(非定律数值,schema 如实标注)。
effect.en: JS-type param: injects the same real usability defect into BOTH sides equally (controlled variable). small-target = menu buttons squashed to 18px tall; slow-response = success feedback delayed 900ms with a 'processing' state. Intent: under an identical defect the refined side's perceived rating drops less — beauty buying tolerance. Both values are demo defect values, not law constants (stated as such).

effect.zh: CSS 变量型参数:精修/高定卡的主色(头部下划线、按钮 hover、成功态)。换主色即可观察「仅配色变化」对完成度观感的影响;素坯档不消费此变量。文字保持固定深色,不随主色变化。
effect.en: CSS-var param: the accent color of the refined/premium cards (header underline, button hover, success state). Swap it to watch a color-only change move the perceived finish; the plain tier ignores this variable. Text stays a fixed dark color regardless of the accent.

note.zh: 演示全部使用原生 DOM/CSS/JS(按钮、range 滑块、transition),无新特性依赖,现代浏览器均可运行。
note.en: The demo uses only native DOM/CSS/JS (buttons, range sliders, transitions) — no cutting-edge features; any modern browser runs it.

fallback.zh: 定律的工程出口:美观不是可降级的 CSS 特性,而是产出流程——把「完成度」作为独立验收项;同时把「美观遮蔽可用性」写进测试规程:可用性测试首轮用未抛光的线框稿,或在抛光版本上强制测量任务用时与错误率,别让好评代替指标。accent 色不支持 oklch 时由浏览器回退到最近可解析色。
fallback.en: The engineering exit: aesthetics is not a degradable CSS feature but a production process — treat 'finish level' as its own acceptance item; and bake 'beauty masks usability' into the test protocol: run the first usability round on unpolished wireframes, or force-measure task time and error rate on the polished build, never letting praise stand in for metrics. If oklch is unsupported the accent falls back to the nearest parseable color.

use.zh: 首屏、注册、支付等信任敏感场景:审美完成度直接决定第一印象与感知品质
use.en: Trust-sensitive surfaces (landing, sign-up, payment): finish level drives first impressions and perceived quality

use.zh: 功能与竞品打平时,用审美完成度建立感知优势
use.en: When features are at parity with competitors, finish level builds a perceived edge

use.zh: 遗留系统/内部工具改版:先补美观,能低成本买到用户对旧问题的容忍
use.en: Legacy or internal-tool redesigns: aesthetics first — it cheaply buys tolerance of the old warts

avoid.zh: 用美观掩盖未解决的可用性缺陷(性能、错误率、可达性)
avoid.en: Using beauty to bury unresolved usability defects (performance, error rates, accessibility)

avoid.zh: 可用性测试只测抛光版本——好评会替代真实指标
avoid.en: Testing only the polished build — praise substitutes for real metrics

avoid.zh: 为了好看牺牲可读性:NN/g 已批评 Liquid Glass 全屏化伤害可读性(调研 03§2)
avoid.en: Sacrificing readability for looks: NN/g criticized Liquid Glass' full-screen use for hurting readability (research 03 §2)

a11y.zh: 审美升级不得破坏对比度与可达性(WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3 4.5:1):本 demo 的 accent 仅用于装饰性下划线、hover 与成功态,文字保持固定深色不随主色漂移;双卡对照不依赖颜色区分——左右各有标题与语义结构;评分用原生 input[type=range] + label,任务状态用文本呈现并 aria-live 播报,不靠动画或颜色传达。
a11y.en: An aesthetic upgrade must not break contrast or accessibility (WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3, 4.5:1): in this demo the accent is decorative only (underline, hover, success) and text keeps a fixed dark color; the A/B sides are distinguished by headings and structure, never by color alone; ratings use native input[type=range] + label, task state is presented as text and announced via aria-live — never conveyed by animation or color alone.

goal.zh: 做一个「同一功能、两种完成度」的 A/B 自测演示:左右两张 ATM 风格卡片各含 4 个功能按钮,任务是完成「查询余额」;每侧记录用时与误点,任务后用 1–7 滑块给该侧打感知易用性分;底部对照条展示感知分差与实测差异,复现「感知比实测更偏心美观」的审美红利。
goal.en: Build an A/B self-experiment demo: two ATM-style cards with the same 4 menu buttons, task = run a balance check; each side records time and misclicks, then the user rates perceived usability 1–7 on a slider; a compare strip shows the perceived-rating gap vs the measured gap, reproducing the aesthetic dividend — perception favors the pretty one more than performance does.

acceptance.zh: beauty/handicap 为 JS 型参数经 store 订阅驱动;accent 为 CSS 变量型(--au-accent)由 DemoStage 注入
acceptance.en: beauty/handicap are JS-type params consumed via store subscription; accent is CSS-var type (--au-accent) injected by DemoStage

acceptance.zh: handicap 对两侧等量注入:small-target=按钮 18px、slow-response=900ms,均为演示缺陷值并如实标注
acceptance.en: handicap injects equally into both sides: small-target = 18px buttons, slow-response = 900ms delay — demo defect values, labeled as such

acceptance.zh: 两侧功能按钮布局与数量完全一致,完成度只改装饰层(圆角/阴影/渐变/留白)
acceptance.en: Both sides keep identical button layout and count; finish level changes only the decoration layer (radius/shadow/gradient/whitespace)

acceptance.zh: 评分用原生 range 滑块 + label,数值文本同步;用时/误点以文本呈现,不只靠颜色
acceptance.en: Ratings use native range sliders + labels with synced numeric text; time/misclicks appear as text, never color-only

acceptance.zh: prefers-reduced-motion 下成功反馈只变色不动效;对照条数值在两侧完成后才出现,未完成时如实显示占位
acceptance.en: Under prefers-reduced-motion the success feedback changes color only; the compare strip only appears after both sides finish, with an honest placeholder otherwise
